<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Represents the result of domain name validation, providing clarity on whether the domain is ASCII-encoded or not.

Description: This class is used to encapsulate the outcome of a domain name validation process. It is instantiated when a domain name needs to be validated, typically by a service responsible for domain management. The class is used by other services to determine if a domain name is ASCII-encoded, which is crucial for handling internationalized domain names.

Attributes:
    ascii_domain (str): Indicates whether the domain name is ASCII-encoded. Set during validation.
    domain (str): The original domain name provided for validation. Remains unchanged throughout the class lifecycle.
</DOCSTRING>
